parsed.restated: ∃ (q : ℕ) (H : SimpleGraph (Fin q)), H.Connected ∧ H.IsBipartite ∧ IsTwoDegenerate H ∧ (∀ coloring : H.Coloring (Fin 2), ∀ side : Fin 2, 2 < (Finset.univ.filter (fun vertex : Fin q => coloring vertex = side)).sup (fun vertex => H.degree vertex)) ∧ ∃ c ε : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < ε ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → c * (n : ℝ) ^ ((3 : ℝ) / 2 + ε) ≤ (SimpleGraph.extremalNumber n H : ℝ)
parsed.english: There is a finite connected bipartite 2-degenerate graph H such that, in every proper 2-colouring, each colour class contains a vertex of degree greater than 2. Moreover there are constants c > 0 and ε > 0 and a threshold N such that for all n ≥ N, ex(n, H) ≥ c·n^(3/2+ε).
parsed.why_clearer: The eventual-in-atTop quantifier is replaced by an explicit threshold N with ∀ n ≥ N, so the lower bound on the extremal number reads as a plain inequality.
